name: 02910 · Cranston, RI
findings: ZIP 02910 (Cranston) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02910 (Cranston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02910 (Cranston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
